findings.description: Safari native model selects ignored the intended comfortable control height.
findings.resolution: Retained native select semantics with explicit appearance and CSS chevrons. Final Safari Settings screenshots inspected for all three candidates; final Chromium select height 46.796875px.

representative_user_task_validation.timing: Whole-design comparison next; representative task validation before production release
representative_user_task_validation.risk: Rule-based inspection does not establish real-user comprehension, mobile keyboard behavior or session reliability.

limitations: Design simulation only: no authentication, elapsed-time session test, provider execution, research, microphone capture, transcription service, persistence, database or GoDaddy operation.
The interactive regression sequence was exercised on Electric shared behavior; state rendering and responsive layout were exercised on all three palettes. No production suite pass is inferred.

No representative-user session, VoiceOver audit, physical mobile keyboard test, Firefox/Edge run, forced-colors rendering test, full Ukrainian interface localization, performance or production security result.
Normal screenshots and live UI were inspected. A tall full-page capture had stitching duplication; it is not used as layout evidence. No raster export is claimed.
